title: js-security-orb run record, version 1
description: What one js-security-orb command ran, on what, and what it found: written as <report_name>.run-record.json when a command's run_record parameter is true. Fields are only ever added within version 1; a change that would break a reader gets a new schema URL.

command.description: The orb command that wrote the record.

outcome.description: passed: no finding fails the gate. findings: findings failed the step. findings-reported: findings, passed because report_only is true. error: a check did not complete, or checked nothing, so there is no verdict, and the step failed.

exit_code.description: The step's exit code: 0 for passed and findings-reported, 1 for findings and error.

ci.description: The CI job the command ran in: a CircleCI job (from CIRCLE_BUILD_URL, CIRCLE_SHA1, CIRCLE_JOB and the project), or a GitHub Actions run (from GITHUB_SERVER_URL, GITHUB_REPOSITORY, GITHUB_RUN_ID, GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT, GITHUB_SHA and GITHUB_JOB); null elsewhere.

working_directory.description: The absolute project directory the command ran in.

checkout_top.description: The top of the git checkout the project is in (or the working directory outside one). Paths in inputs, and in the reports' locations, are relative to it.

node.description: The Node.js that ran the orb's helper.

parameters.description: The command's parameters as the helper read them, after environment variables were expanded. token is the name of a variable, never its value.

registry.description: Where package metadata came from: the registry, the scope registries (from the scopes parameter and the project's .npmrc), and the name of the variable holding the registry's token, if any. URLs only, never credentials.

inputs.description: The files the result depends on: the lockfiles (with their format and number of entries) and the project's .npmrc.

sha256.description: null when the file could not be read.

counts.description: The command's summary of what it found: lockfiles, entries, findings, failing findings, errors and findings by rule, plus the command's own counts.

results.description: One entry per item checked, where the command reports items; null otherwise.

reports.description: Every report the command wrote before this record, with its SHA-256.
